label: pass2-final
methodology: Fresh canister per workload/trial; configure inputs outside measurement; four forced GC increments before each operation. Each update measures one call using performanceCounter(0) and rts_total_allocation, retains its output, and replies after measurement. Raw counts include counter/assignment overhead; control is reported separately. Ordinary to_candid has different semantics and is context, not an equivalent implementation.
correctness: SHA-256 checked against Python hashlib expected digests generated with inputs. CandidX checked against host canonicalization of ordinary Candid. Output digests allow baseline/candidate equivalence checks.
